verdict.title: Add --scalar flag to glom CLI for unquoted single value output
verdict.unchecked_changes: The commit message also mentions a fix for the packaging tox job, which is not covered by the provided fail-to-pass tests.
verdict.statement: When using the `glom` command-line interface, there is no option to output single, non-collection values without JSON formatting (i.e., without quotes and whitespace). This makes it difficult to use the output directly in shell scripts or other tools that expect raw values. A new `--scalar` flag should be introduced. When this flag is present and the result of the `glom` operation is a scalar value (not a list, dict, etc.), it should be printed directly to standard output without any surrounding quotes or JSON formatting. If the result is not a scalar, the output should remain standard JSON. The CLI should recognize and process the `--scalar` flag.
verdict.reason: The change adds a new feature to the CLI, and the provided fail-to-pass test directly addresses this new functionality.

required_interface.name: scalar
required_interface.description: boolean flag for the CLI, controlling output format for scalar values
